# CLI reference

Install: `npm i -g @obbyx/cli` (Node 24+). Every command also prints its section with `--help`.

## obbyx

```text
obbyx — x402 payments on Obyte

Usage: obbyx <command> [options]

Commands:
  obbyx init            Create a local wallet
  obbyx address         Show your address
  obbyx balance         Show your balance
  obbyx faucet          Get free testnet bytes (once per 24 h)
  obbyx pay <url>       Call a paid API, paying at most --max
  obbyx doctor          Check wallet, hub, balance, pending payments
  obbyx logs <files..>  Follow one payment through JSON log files
  obbyx decode <value>  Decode an x402 header (PAYMENT-REQUIRED / -SIGNATURE / -RESPONSE)
  obbyx channel         Payment channels: open, list, status, deposit, close, confirm

Options:
      --network  Obyte network
     [string] [choices: "testnet", "livenet", "obyte:testnet", "obyte:livenet"] [default: "testnet"]
      --hub      Obyte hub WebSocket URL                                                    [string]
  -h, --help     Show help                                                                 [boolean]

Environment:
  OBBYX_HOME  wallet directory (default ~/.obbyx)
  LOG_LEVEL   logging to stderr (default warn)

Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error/usage, 2 refused (HTTP error, faucet refusal), 3 pending (retry later)
```

## `obbyx pay`

```text
obbyx pay <url>

Call a paid API, paying at most --max

Positionals:
  url  URL of the paid API                                                       [string] [required]

Options:
      --network  Obyte network
     [string] [choices: "testnet", "livenet", "obyte:testnet", "obyte:livenet"] [default: "testnet"]
      --hub      Obyte hub WebSocket URL                                                    [string]
      --max      Spending limit for this call, in GBYTE (e.g. 0.00002)           [string] [required]
      --method   HTTP method (default GET, or POST with --data)                             [string]
      --data     Request body (JSON by default)                                             [string]
      --header   Extra header 'Name: value' (repeatable)                                     [array]
      --payment  Retry a pending request with the same payment (printed by pay)             [string]
      --wait     How long to wait for the payment to become final, seconds (testnet can take
                 minutes). It never pays twice meanwhile.                  [string] [default: "600"]
      --max-fee  Most network fee (bytes) an on-chain (exact) payment may cost
                                                                         [string] [default: "10000"]
  -h, --help     Show help                                                                 [boolean]
```

## `obbyx logs`

```text
obbyx logs <files..>

Follow one payment through JSON log files

Positionals:
  files  JSON log files                                             [array] [required] [default: []]

Options:
      --network  Obyte network
     [string] [choices: "testnet", "livenet", "obyte:testnet", "obyte:livenet"] [default: "testnet"]
      --hub      Obyte hub WebSocket URL                                                    [string]
      --binding  Only entries of this payment binding                                       [string]
      --proof    Only entries of this proof id                                              [string]
      --aa       Only entries of this channel AA                                            [string]
      --request  Only entries of this request id                                            [string]
      --level    Minimum level (debug, info, warn, ...)                                     [string]
  -h, --help     Show help                                                                 [boolean]
```

## `obbyx channel`

```text
obbyx channel

Payment channels: open, list, status, deposit, close, confirm

Commands:
  obbyx channel open <target>     Open a payment channel to a seller (instant micropayments)
  obbyx channel list              List your channels
  obbyx channel status <target>   Show a channel (balances, spent, period)
  obbyx channel deposit <target>  Top up a channel
  obbyx channel close <target>    Start closing a channel (the dispute window begins)
  obbyx channel confirm <target>  Finish closing after the dispute window and get the rest back

Options:
      --network  Obyte network
     [string] [choices: "testnet", "livenet", "obyte:testnet", "obyte:livenet"] [default: "testnet"]
      --hub      Obyte hub WebSocket URL                                                    [string]
  -h, --help     Show help                                                                 [boolean]
```

## `obbyx channel open`

```text
obbyx channel open <target>

Open a payment channel to a seller (instant micropayments)

Positionals:
  target  Seller address                                                         [string] [required]

Options:
      --network  Obyte network
     [string] [choices: "testnet", "livenet", "obyte:testnet", "obyte:livenet"] [default: "testnet"]
      --hub      Obyte hub WebSocket URL                                                    [string]
      --deposit  Deposit, GBYTE                                                  [string] [required]
      --window   Dispute window, seconds (sellers require a minimum)     [string] [default: "86400"]

```
